summary: Document the tools/content Python requirements (Pillow, openpyxl) in the README and have tools/bootstrap.py report them against their pins. The report only warns: unreadable or undecodable requirements, unsupported lines and bad names never change bootstrap's exit code (set -e launchers call it), and bootstrap never runs pip. Pins accept spacing, extras and markers; versions compare with trailing zeros equal; names resolve case/-/_ spellings. The warning names the running interpreter and absolute requirements path, and notes check.sh's L5R_PYTHON/python3/python order. New tools/test_bootstrap.py (12 tests) runs from tools/check.sh. Addresses the unhappy-path review of PR #508.
validation: Windows 11, Git Bash, Python 3.14: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client, All requested checks passed (Python 45+135+6+12 tests OK; 2200/2200 engine, AI, server and transport). The 12 new bootstrap tests fail 8 of 12 against the previous bootstrap.py. Live python tools/bootstrap.py: Ready, exit 0. Client unchanged by this commit; full client check passed on the earlier rebase. Not run on macOS.
